description: Append-only record of one acceptance of a binding text (AJA-1781). The shape is contracts/terms_acceptance.schema.json. A new acceptance writes a new record. An old record is never changed or deleted. The record name is the acceptance_id.

fields.description: Id of the binding text. Example: terms-of-use.
fields.label: Terms ID

fields.description: Version of the text that was shown. It must be a published PLT Terms Version.
fields.label: Terms Version

fields.description: Language of the text on the screen at the moment of acceptance. It is not the account language of the user.
fields.label: Shown Locale

fields.description: Keycloak subject (sub) of the user who accepted.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Moment of acceptance in UTC, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix.
fields.label: Accepted At (UTC)

name: PLT Terms Acceptance
